description: Show every repository under a folder: branch, commits, uncommitted files, unpushed work and remote

depth.description: How many folder levels to search for repositories; 3 by default <1-10>

folder.description: A repository, or a folder holding repositories; the current folder by default

name: git.status

allGood.description: Every repository has a remote, nothing is unpushed, and all are on one branch.

isRepository.description: The folder is one repository, not a workspace holding several.

ahead.description: null when the branch has no upstream.

branch.description: The branch, a short commit id for a detached HEAD, or `?`.

dirty.description: Files with uncommitted changes, as `git status` counts them.

name.description: Relative to the folder given, with `/`; the folder's own name when it is the repository.

output.description: What a program the command ran printed

truncated.description: Where the result was cut to fit, and how much
